scope: Independent source review of reflection integration, configuration, frame graph and production HLSL

closed_findings.observed: The first trace and color mip inputs excluded environment specular from reflected source radiance.
closed_findings.resolution: ReflectionRadiance writes base plus environment specular into the reusable full-resolution output. Mips and trace read this complete source before final composite overwrites the output.

closed_findings.observed: UploadFloatTexture initially left the BRDF LUT in pixel-shader-only resource state while TraceCS reads it at t10.
closed_findings.resolution: Float environment upload now ends in combined pixel and non-pixel shader read state.

closed_findings.observed: The accepted first depth cell residual modulated SSR confidence, creating horizontal bands on a planar receiver. CPU reconstruction of 83 actual captured pixels agreed with GPU alpha within 0.00048828125.
closed_findings.resolution: The accepted slab remains the hit criterion. Confidence retains screen-edge, roughness and hit-normal factors. The discontinuous depth residual weight is removed.
closed_findings.regression: A planar-depth grid with seven source offsets must return accepted confidence one. Existing separated surfaces and zero-thickness miss cases remain covered.

checks: C++ explicit types, C++17 no-exception compilation and isolated MSVC plus clang test builds.
Strict optional reflection fields, finite ranges, disabled validation and transactional parse.
Radiance writes before mip and trace reads, trace completes before composite writes, all reused resources return to common.
Per-frame descriptor ranges 104 through 118 remain within 120 descriptors and separate from global history, material and environment views.
Trace root constants are 64 bytes at b0. Frame constants are 3120 bytes at b1 with DXIL offsets matching C++ assertions.
Lighting selects two HDR render targets when enabled and the original one-target shader path when disabled.
All reflection terms carry the current pre-exposure once. Composite replaces environment specular by confidence and preserves direct, diffuse and emissive terms.
TAA, histogram, bloom and tone mapping consume the composite HDR output for enabled reflections.
Resize flushes graphics and compute queues, collects pending timings, releases reflection targets and rebuilds them.
Runtime graphics timestamps derive from compiled pass count.
All four reflection compute entry points compile with DXC strict mode and warnings as errors.
verification_boundary: Independent source and CPU/DXC review with final r4 build identity. Actual r3 GPU runs remain historical and are labeled r3. Actual final r4 GPU images and RenderDoc are owned by the capture agent. Final live network evidence is recorded separately.

r3_build_identity.identity_check_scope: Historical observation before the r4 trace confidence fix. The zero mismatch result applied at that observation. Final current-source identity is recorded in final_build.

shader_inspection_scope: Historical r3 shader inspection validates root bindings and cbuffer layout. R4 changes only trace hit-confidence weighting and retains those bindings and layouts.

metadata_paths.normalization: Artifact paths are repository-relative. External input bytes were copied unchanged into the ignored evidence-inputs directory. Displayed compiler and Python command names omit host installation paths. Original command and metadata bytes are retained in the private archive.
